label: Your questions, answered
html:
(FAQs)

Your Questions, Answered

Helping you understand our process and offerings at LLW.

Ask something else

Do you only design, or do you build the website too?

Both. We handle structure, design, code and launch — a website built from scratch, fast, mobile-first and yours to own, with no page-builder lock-in.

Can you fix an existing site you did not build?

Yes, that is a large part of what we do. Send us the URL and access, and we come back the same working day with what is wrong, what it costs and how long it takes.

Do you handle SEO as well?

Yes. Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, schema and sitemaps — clean markup, fast pages and correct metadata, with a before/after report.

You are on Fiverr too — should I book there or here?

Either works — it is the same team and the same code. Fiverr suits a single fixed-price gig with payment held until you approve; booking direct suits full plans like the Launch Plan or Growth Retainer.

What if I am not satisfied with the work?

You get your money back — no arguments, no paperwork. Every plan carries a 100% money-back guarantee.

How affordable is this really?

Quick fixes start at $39, full websites at $249 and ongoing care at $199/month — fixed prices, priced per fix rather than per hour.
